title: Prove one-disk cutover readiness
goal: After T001/T002, ancestry-preserving source integration, the T004 activation-mechanism proof, storage-harness implementation, final source integration/publication/seal and the final T011 published-source closure build proof are terminal and reviewed, prove one-disk NixOS cutover readiness on an exclusively reserved disposable non-production target using only the leased immutable T010 published-source artifact and the exact T011 final closure/build receipt: first create and independently read back the canonical GPT+EFI+recovery+LUKS2+Btrfs topology, then boot a distinct receipt-bound prior/recovery runtime derived only from T010 on that topology, then derive and review a target-bound Activation receipt from the exact T011 Build receipt and the proven disposable target/prior-runtime identity, activate exactly the T011 closure through that Activation receipt without source reevaluation, independently read back the live closure and prove rollback to that prior/recovery runtime, restore independently sourced off-host backup material, prove offline recovery, and finish with a reviewed evidence-complete cutover plan whose actual production device remains deliberately unbound for a later separately authorized destructive order.

approval.note: Runtime/block-device mutation is authorized only inside the exclusively reserved disposable storage-rehearsal sandbox and only after T004, T007, T008, T009, T010 and the final T011 closure build/identity proof are terminal. Declarative/reconstruction source acquisition is restricted to the separately leased immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source produced by T010 from the exact terminal T009 merge-commit tree; /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git, mutable worktrees, moving branches, main itself, mutable locks and unpinned remote sources are outside T003 authority and must not be read for reconstruction or boot. The productive Heim-PC block devices, EFI, Secure-Boot, firmware, boot state and OS remain outside this authority. T004 proves the mechanism only. After the disposable GPT/LUKS/Btrfs topology is created and independently read back, T003 must boot a distinct receipt-bound prior/recovery runtime derived only from T010 on that target; only then may it derive and review a separate target-bound Activation receipt binding the exact T011 managed-build receipt, final closure, disposable target identity, prior/recovery identity and Activation effect class; only that Activation receipt may authorize activation, live readback and rollback.

acceptance.assertion: Before any block-device/runtime effect, T007 is terminal and independently reviewed, and T003 binds its exact final integration commit/tree plus terminal rehearsal-source artifact manifest and receipt as predecessor lineage evidence. Evidence proves exact T006 and T005 commits are ancestors and exact T001/T002 commits transitively through T006; any ancestry-broken or incomplete lineage blocks T003 even though runtime source bytes are later taken only from T010's published-source artifact.

T008 is terminal and independently reviewed; its exact protected publication PR handoff binds repository, PR number, fixed branch, base/head, canonical diff, CI/review settlement and exact T007/T006/T005/T001/T002 lineage. T003 treats this as pre-merge lineage evidence only and grants it no merge/source authority.

T009 is terminal and independently reviewed. Its exact Captain merge receipt proves the exact T008 PR was merged with merge_method=merge from the reviewed head/base/diff, records the actual merge commit/tree, and proves protected main contains exact T007/T006/T005/T001/T002 commits as ancestors. Ambiguous or different merge identity fails closed.

T010 is terminal and independently reviewed, and artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source manifest binds exactly the terminal T009 merge commit/tree—not a later moving main tip—plus T009 receipt/Captain digests, reviewed T008 PR identity, predecessor ancestry, content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. Artifact/tree mismatch fails closed before T003 runtime effect. T010's historical pre-repair label naming T011 as the final activation-reproof task is treated only as immutable source-seal provenance; repaired effect authority is defined by T011 Build evidence plus T003's target-bound Activation receipt.

T004 is terminal and independently reviewed and proves the managed build/activation, fail-closed denial and rollback mechanism on the earlier T006 source. T003 retains T004 only as mechanism evidence; the T004 closure cannot satisfy final activation identity.

T011 is terminal and independently reviewed. Before any T003 block-device/runtime effect, T003 binds the exact T011 managed-build receipt and final closure identity to the exact T010 published-source artifact/T009 merge commit tree. The T011 Build receipt alone is explicitly insufficient activation authority; T011 activation/live-readback/rollback evidence is neither required nor accepted because T003 must derive its own target-bound Activation receipt after disposable-target proof. A failed, stale, source-mismatched or T004-only closure proof blocks T003 before any block-device effect.

Before declarative source bytes are read, T003 holds the artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source read claim materialized as the exact artifact path lease. Independent re-hash verifies the content-addressed artifact and manifest exactly match T010's exact T009 merge-commit tree and bind predecessor ancestry, content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity.

Reconstruction and boot source acquisition read only the leased immutable T010 published-source artifact. T003 has no /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git lease and no live source-path lease; any attempted read or reevaluation from the Git object store, mutable checkout, branch, main, mutable lock or unpinned remote fails closed before block-device/runtime effect.

Before sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs or boot mutation, the run holds the exclusive service.heim-pc-nixos-storage-rehearsal-sandbox claim and fresh independent evidence proves the target is a blank disposable virtual disk whose backing is not the productive Heim-PC root/system disk, not any mounted production filesystem and not production EFI/firmware state; ambiguity fails closed before effect.

Starting from the independently proven blank disposable virtual disk and only the verified T010 published-source artifact, T003 creates the exact production-target topology GPT + EFI System Partition + recovery/boot-recovery surface + LUKS2 + Btrfs with @root, @nix, @persist, @home, @data and @containers, proves LUKS unlock and independently reads back every required partition, filesystem and subvolume mount. Before the final T011 closure is activated, T003 must additionally boot on that exact topology a distinct receipt-bound prior/recovery runtime derived only from T010/locked inputs, prove that it exposes executable switch-to-configuration and independently read back its live identity. That prior/recovery runtime is mechanism/recovery state only and is explicitly not accepted as the final T011 closure identity.

Only after exact-storage-rehearsal has independently proven both the disposable storage topology and the distinct live receipt-bound prior/recovery runtime, T003 derives and independently reviews a separate Activation receipt bound to the exact T011 managed-Build receipt, exact T010/T009 source identity, exact immutable final closure, exact disposable sandbox target identity, exact prior/recovery runtime, rollback metadata and Activation effect class. The T011 Build receipt or a caller-supplied closure string alone is insufficient authority; any missing, stale or mismatched binding fails closed before switch-to-configuration.

Only after exact-storage-rehearsal and final-published-source-activation-receipt-bound are satisfied, T003 consumes that reviewed target-bound Activation receipt and activates exactly the immutable final closure named by the bound T011 Build receipt through the managed activation contract. The activation performs no Git, branch/main, lock or remote-input reevaluation. Independent live readback proves /run/current-system or the equivalent running-system identity equals the exact T011 closure.

Inside the same disposable storage-rehearsal target and same boot/recovery context, after successful Activation-receipt-bound T011 closure activation and live readback, rollback consumes the exact prior/recovery identity and rollback metadata bound by that Activation receipt. Independent readback proves return to the expected prior/recovery identity without mutable-source reevaluation; the prior/recovery runtime is explicitly not promoted to final activation identity.

Fresh read-only inventory classifies every migration-relevant non-reproducible data class separately from caches and rebuildable state; current scoped backup success is not treated as proof of complete cutover coverage.

Every critical migration data class is covered by sufficient physically/logically independent off-host storage and a staged realistic restore into the disposable rehearsal sandbox proves representative usable content; a capacity-constrained, production-disk-backed or non-independently-restorable backup target cannot satisfy this gate.

A fresh disposable system is reconstructed exclusively from the verified T010 content-addressed published-source artifact plus independently restored non-reproducible data, demonstrating that neither Git object-store access, mutable checkout state, hidden production-host state nor the original system disk is required for recovery. After topology proof and receipt-bound activation, boot/live readback binds the reconstructed running system to the exact T011 final closure and its T010/T009 source identity.

Independent bootable recovery media plus the required offline host/control closure, verified published-source artifact, lock/trust roots and LUKS/recovery material are verified without Grabowski, Bureau, network or the production system SSD.

The cutover plan defines the exact later device-binding procedure and required fresh evidence for model, serial number, mounts, root backing, health and recovery readiness, but deliberately leaves the actual production block-device identity unbound until a separate destructive cutover order authorizes it; historical WD_BLACK SN850X/nvme0n1 evidence is orientation only.

The terminal artifact is a reviewed evidence object/plan binding the T004 mechanism proof, final T011 published-source closure/build proof, T003 exact topology proof plus target-bound Activation receipt and final-source activation/live-readback/rollback evidence, exact T007 lineage evidence, exact T008 protected-PR handoff, exact T009 Captain merge receipt and T010 published-source artifact digest/source merge commit-tree, exact target topology, point of no return, rollback/reconstruction procedure, mandatory post-boot readback and all prerequisite backup/recovery evidence, while containing no current authorization or production block-device binding for the real cutover.

Although destructive commands are required inside the exclusive disposable sandbox, this task terminates before sgdisk, wipefs, cryptsetup luksFormat, mkfs, real EFI-partition mutation, Secure-Boot key mutation, firmware write, productive nixos-install, productive switch or reboot into a new production OS on the Heim-PC; such effects require a later explicit destructive-action order bound to fresh production-device and recovery evidence.

Exact T004 mechanism proof, T011 final published-source closure/build proof, T003 target-bound Activation receipt plus final-source activation/live-readback/rollback proof, T007 source-artifact/lineage, T008 protected-PR handoff, T009 protected merge, T010 published-source artifact, target-preflight, storage topology, boot/readback, backup restore, fresh reconstruction, offline recovery and final-plan evidence are independently reviewed before T003 is considered terminal.

metadata.historical_device_reference_not_authorit: WD_BLACK SN850X 2TB / historical nvme0n1 orientation only; actual production device identity is intentionally unbound in this task
metadata.final_runtime_order: T003 proves disposable storage topology, boots and reads back a distinct T010-bound prior/recovery runtime on it, then activates/read-backs/rolls back the exact T011 receipt-bound final closure
metadata.historical_t010_activation_label_disposi: T010 remains immutable source-seal authority; its pre-repair T011 activation-reproof wording is provenance only and does not override T003's target-bound Activation authority.
